verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document any export of results to documents, spreadsheets, or reference-manager formats such as RIS, BibTeX, Zotero, or EndNote. Creating Markdown notes and custom tables inside the workspace are related in-app features, not export capabilities, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a researcher, I can export results to common formats, including documents, spreadsheets, and reference-manager files
